title: Octopus — Usage
description: Electricity & gas usage. Resolution auto-selects from the time range (<7d raw 30-min, <90d hourly, <2y daily, else monthly), or pick a fixed resolution with the Resolution dropdown.

panels.title: Electricity (kWh)  —  import up / export down  ·  ${resolution} resolution

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket(make_interval(secs => $__interval_ms/1000.0), interval_start) AS time, sum(consumption) FILTER (WHERE not is_export) AS "Import", -sum(consumption) FILTER (WHERE is_export) AS "Export" FROM consumption WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start) AND fuel='electricity' AND ('${resolution}'='raw' OR ('${resolution}'='auto' AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) < 604800)) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket(make_interval(secs => $__interval_ms/1000.0), hour), sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE not is_export), -sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE is_export) FROM cagg_consumption_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND fuel='electricity' AND ('${resolution}'='hourly' OR ('${resolution}'='auto' AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) >= 604800 AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) < 7776000)) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket(make_interval(secs => $__interval_ms/1000.0), day), sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE not is_export), -sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE is_export) FROM cagg_consumption_daily WHERE day >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND day < $__timeTo()::timestamp AND fuel='electricity' AND ('${resolution}'='daily' OR ('${resolution}'='auto' AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) >= 7776000 AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) < 63072000)) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT month AS time, sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE not is_export), -sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE is_export) FROM cagg_consumption_monthly WHERE month >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND month < $__timeTo()::timestamp AND fuel='electricity' AND ('${resolution}'='monthly' OR ('${resolution}'='auto' AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) >= 63072000)) GROUP BY month ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket(make_interval(secs => $__interval_ms/1000.0), interval_start) AS time, sum(consumption)*${gas_kwh_per_m3} AS "Gas kWh" FROM consumption WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start) AND fuel='gas' AND ('${resolution}'='raw' OR ('${resolution}'='auto' AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) < 604800)) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket(make_interval(secs => $__interval_ms/1000.0), hour), sum(kwh)*${gas_kwh_per_m3} FROM cagg_consumption_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND fuel='gas' AND ('${resolution}'='hourly' OR ('${resolution}'='auto' AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) >= 604800 AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) < 7776000)) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket(make_interval(secs => $__interval_ms/1000.0), day), sum(kwh)*${gas_kwh_per_m3} FROM cagg_consumption_daily WHERE day >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND day < $__timeTo()::timestamp AND fuel='gas' AND ('${resolution}'='daily' OR ('${resolution}'='auto' AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) >= 7776000 AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) < 63072000)) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT month AS time, sum(kwh)*${gas_kwh_per_m3} FROM cagg_consumption_monthly WHERE month >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND month < $__timeTo()::timestamp AND fuel='gas' AND ('${resolution}'='monthly' OR ('${resolution}'='auto' AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) >= 63072000)) GROUP BY month ORDER BY 1
